verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any element-selection or visual editing mode for changing text, style, or layout without a prompt. The documented workflow is chat-driven: you describe changes and watch the preview update. Browsing and editing source code is a different capability from selecting an element in the preview and editing it directly, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip
